question: Does the official NLC 2025 Yangzhou publication establish public original-page access to provincial-gazette item02273 Xu-An1599 古今律曆考, and can the 2024 Yangzhou library reader establish its juan45 leaf?

direct_official_evidence.issuer: 中国国家图书馆/国家古籍保护中心
direct_official_evidence.observed: First-party 10th joint release item explicitly states 43 Yangzhou Library ancient-book works released, all Yangzhou holdings included in the national precious-ancient-books list; source emits collection link http://read.nlc.cn/allSearch/searchList?searchType=109&showType=1&pageNo=1.
First-party announcement verifies guji.nlc.cn public intelligent ancient-book service, but no 02273 item/juan45 bound by the announcement.
Prior 13XS exact provincial precious-book row02273 labels Xu-An1599 72卷（有补配）at Yangzhou Library. This provincial-list row is not proven to be among the NLC's 43 nationally listed releases.

independent_route_context.publisher: 扬州发布; 江苏广电荔枝新闻转载
independent_route_context.observed: Reports Yangzhou self-built digital platform opened with 85 titles, book image and text comparison modes; gives platform-level capability, not exact historical item presence.
Public homepage exposes 数字资源 and 馆藏目录 navigation; the exact 02273 item path/卷45 was not observed.
Secondary user testimony says Yangzhou reader needs registration or login; not independently verified as a provider-wide mandatory condition.

bounded_access_and_search.current_text_search_surface: Public guji.nlc.cn homepage opens but exposes zero readable lines in the present web text retriever; title- and source-specific public web searches yielded no exact Yangzhou02273 page. This is tool/index scope, not negative item proof.
bounded_access_and_search.institutional_email_status: No new NLC reply seen on user-driven 2026-11-14 mail search after prior 13XK; prior Tianjin reply was already recorded in 13XJ. No new correspondence was sent.

transmission_impact: NONE: provider and discovery route only, no edition/physical-target glyph or lineage relation verified
next_action: Use only free anonymous first-party item links emitted by the NLC searchType=109 Yangzhou subcollection or other authenticated Xu-An1599 holdings; first establish whether item02273 is among those 43 national-list titles and whether juan45 is intact/unreplaced. If listing is absent or requires account, continue independent public Xu-An original folio routes and wait for existing 13XK NLC inquiry reply in user-driven future sessions. No duplicate generic mail or paid copying.
